summary.text: Daniel Norber was elected to the New York State Assembly on November 5, 2024, and represents the 16th Assembly District in Nassau County, which includes Great Neck, Manhasset, Port Washington and Williston Park.
His official biography says he was raised in Israel, served in the Israel Defense Forces and built a moving business in New York.

paragraphs.text: Norber was born in the United States and raised in Israel, according to his Assembly biography, and he is a first-generation American whose grandparents survived the Holocaust.

He was drafted into the Israel Defense Forces at 17 and served as a staff sergeant in the military police, and he later earned a bachelor's degree in political science and government from Reichman University.

The biography says he moved to New York City shortly before September 11, worked in consumer sales and managed a restaurant group, then founded a moving company and invested in industrial real estate.

It describes his platform as aimed at helping middle-class working families, restoring laws on crime, addressing the migrant crisis and improving access to and the affordability of education and health care.
He and his wife, Inbal, have four children, and he is involved with community groups supporting veterans through Samaritan Village and women through Women In Need.
